question: How many wild poliovirus cases did Pakistan and Afghanistan report in 2025?
text:
In 2025, the two countries reported 52 wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) cases between them. Afghanistan had 21 and Pakistan had 31.[1] This comes from the WHO Polio IHR Emergency Committee's November 2026 statement.

Earlier reports gave lower numbers because they were written before all 2025 cases had been confirmed. One December 2025 report listed 9 cases in Afghanistan and 30 in Pakistan[2]. Afghanistan's total rose later because some cases with 2025 paralysis onset were reported in 2026. The 52 figure is the most recent.

For comparison, in 2024 Afghanistan recorded 25 cases and Pakistan 74[3], so the 2025 total was well below the 2024 total.

Sources:
[1] https://www.who.int/news/item/13-11-2026-statement-of-the-forty-sixth-meeting-of-the-polio-ihr-emergency-committee
[2] https://atlaspress.news/en/2025/12/22/39-wild-polio-cases-afghanistan-pakistan-2025/
[3] https://amu.tv/250895/
